scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @securewatch/api" "npm run dev -w @securewatch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @securewatch/shared && npm run build -w @securewatch/api && npm run build -w @securewatch/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @securewatch/shared && npm run typecheck -w @securewatch/api && npm run typecheck -w @securewatch/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @securewatch/shared && npm run lint -w @securewatch/api && npm run lint -w @securewatch/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @securewatch/shared && npm run test -w @securewatch/api && npm run test -w @securewatch/web
